notes: Delivered mechanism: two concerted, strongly asynchronous [3+2] cycloadditions of HCNO (C#[N+][O-]) to the C4=C5 bond of norbornene, one on each face relative to the methano bridge C10. Bond changes on both edges: break C1#N [1,2] and C4=C5 [4,5]; form C1-C4 [1,4] and O3-C5 [3,5] (1-based atom map of [CH:1]#[N+:2][O-:3].[CH:4]1=[CH:5][CH:6]2[CH2:7][CH2:8][CH:9]1[CH2:10]2).

Barriers (electronic, no ZPE/thermal, each against that channel's own lowest verified contact minimum): syn-C10 10.77 kcal/mol, anti-C10 16.18 kcal/mol. No favoured channel is claimed: the two barriers are referenced to different complexes, and the contact-minimum difference (0.47 kcal/mol, anti lower) and product difference (1.62 kcal/mol, syn lower) are separate quantities, not a common-reference facial selectivity.

Stereochemistry of the product nodes is stated in their smiles lists: syn-C10 C1=NO[C@H]2[C@@H]3CC[C@@H](C3)[C@@H]12 (C4=S, C5=S, isoxazoline ring syn to C10) and anti-C10 C1=NO[C@@H]2[C@@H]3CC[C@@H](C3)[C@H]12 (C4=R, C5=R, ring anti to C10). The two products are diastereomers of an achiral substrate, as the two faces require. The stereochemistry was perceived from the optimised 3D coordinates (RDKit AssignStereochemistryFrom3D) and independently re-derived by the Supervisor.

Nodes RC_synC10 / P_synC10 / RC_antiC10 / P_antiC10 are the same minima declared with the plain connectivity strings; they are retained as reference nodes with their own accepted evidence, while the delivered edges use the stereo-declared occurrences (RC_*_st -> P_*_st) that carry the same native logs.

Exploratory branch kept out of the delivered graph: single-bond-first (stepwise) C-C or C-O addition was searched at GFN2-xTB and produced no zwitterionic single-bond minimum on either face (holding only C1-C4 drives O3...C5 to 3.65-3.81 A and vice versa, 3.57-3.83 A), so the concerted edge is the operative pathway.

Contact-complex search supporting the barrier references: eight syn starts and four anti starts were screened; the syn lowest minimum is the tilted contact (C1...C4 4.152 A) reproduced from a rigid parallel 2.80-3.00 A start (-441.019350291/-441.019350302 Ha), with a second syn conformer at +0.42 kcal/mol (exo_synC10/rc_conf/confB_s10.log); all anti starts relax to the single basin -441.0200955 Ha, and a rigid parallel 2.8-3.3 A stack is not a stationary point on either face (anti single point +29.0 kcal/mol).

Conditions and limits: gas phase, neutral singlet, B3LYP/def2-SVP with D3(BJ) dispersion, Ultrafine integration, SCF=Tight (Gaussian 16 rev C.01), electronic energies only. Jobs ran at %nprocshared=4 and %mem=8GB instead of the instructed 10 cores / 10 GB because the shared node was scheduled sequentially; this changes only wall-clock time, not the level of theory. Web search was unavailable, so the literature background reference (DOI 10.1039/FT9938900029, 1,3-dipolar cycloadditions of fulminic acid) is cited unretrieved and the regiochemistry rests on the computed evidence.
